messages.context: 护符理由：塑形技能不足以稳定塑形
messages.en: you lack the shapeshifting skill to coax this talisman into a stable form.
messages.zh: 你的塑形技能不足以将此护符塑成稳定形态。

messages.context: 护符理由：永远无法习得塑形技能
messages.en: you can never gain the skill to use this talisman.
messages.zh: 你永远无法习得使用此护符所需的技能。

messages.context: 护符理由：须先离开临时形态
messages.en: you need to leave your temporary form first.
messages.zh: 你需要先离开当前的临时形态。

source.anchor: cannot_put_on_talisman_reason; player not in default form and temp

messages.context: 护符理由：在欧卡沃鲁名义下已发誓不结盟
messages.en: you have forsworn all allies in Okawaru's name.
messages.zh: 你已以欧卡沃鲁之名发誓不与任何盟友结伴。

source.anchor: cannot_put_on_talisman_reason; hive form and worship Okawaru

messages.context: 护符理由：背包无法再容纳物品
messages.en: You can't carry that many items.

source.anchor: use_talisman; talisman outside inventory and no inventory room

messages.context: 变形护符触发后转化成指定护符类型
messages.en: {item} responds to your shapeshifting skill and transforms into a {form}!
messages.zh: {item}响应你的塑形技能，变形成了{form}！

messages.context: 开始变形前的危险区域确认
中断变形延迟时的继续确认
危险变形提示：变形会导致烧伤
messages.en: Transforming right now would cause you to burn!

messages.context: 危险变形提示：变形会导致溺亡
messages.en: Transforming right now would cause you to drown!

messages.context: 危险变形提示：变形会震碎诅咒或脆弱物品

source.anchor: transforming_is_unsafe; forced removal of cursed or fragile artefact, transform

messages.context: 危险变形提示：解除变形会导致烧伤
messages.en: Untransforming right now would cause you to burn!
messages.zh: 现在解除变形会让你烧伤！

messages.context: 危险变形提示：解除变形会导致溺亡
messages.en: Untransforming right now would cause you to drown!
messages.zh: 现在解除变形会让你溺亡！

messages.context: 危险变形提示：解除变形会震碎诅咒或脆弱物品
